questions.question: Two trains of length 140 m and 100 m long are going on a parallel track in same direction at a speed of 90 km/h and 18 km/h respectively. What is the time taken for the trains to cross each other completely?
questions.solution:
∵ The trains are moving in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds

⇒ Relative speed of trains = 90 – 18 = 72 km/hr. = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/sec.

Now,

Time taken by trains to cross each other = Sum of lengths of trains/Their relative speed

⇒ Time taken by trains to cross each other = (140 + 100)/20 = 12 sec.

∴ The trains will completely cross each other in 12 seconds

questions.question: What is the volume of water required to fill 2/3rd of a cylindrical tank whose height is 18 cm and the radius is 2 cm?
questions.solution:
For a cylinder with height ‘h’ and radius ‘r’, volume = πr²h

∵ Only 2/3 of the tank is to be filled,

⇒ Volume of water required = 2/3 × π × (2)² × 18

∴ Volume of water required = 48π cm³

questions.question:
The statement given below is followed by two conclusions labeled I and II. Select the conclusion(s) that logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statement: **In a match between India and Shri Lanka India scored 350 runs in 50 overs. Man of the Match MS Dhoni made 175 runs in the match.

**Conclusion**

I: 50% runs were made by the Captain.

II. Half of the runs were made by spinners.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **option 4. Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows**

There is no information given on the runs scored by the captain of the team or the spinners. For that matter, nothing about the spinners or the captain of the team is mentioned in the statement.

Therefore, neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

questions.question: A train runs at 54 kmph. If it takes 15 seconds to cross a pole, then what is the length of the train in meters?
questions.solution:
Speed of train = 54 km/hr. = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/sec.

Now,

Length of train = Speed of train × Time taken to cross the pole

∴ Length of train = 15 × 15 = 225 m

questions.question: Ajitha borrowed Rs. 90,000 at 10% per annum simple interest. On the same day, she lent the sum to her friend at the same rate but compounded annually. How much does she gain at the end of 3 years?
questions.solution:
∵ Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

⇒ Simple interest paid by her = (90000 × 10 × 3)/100 = Rs. 27000

Also,

When the interest is compounded annually,

Compound interest = Principal × [(1 + Rate/100)Time – 1]

⇒ CI earned by her = 90000 × [(1 + 10/100)3 – 1] = 90000 × 0.331 = Rs. 29790

∴ Her gain = 29790 – 27000 = Rs. 2790

questions.question: Two inlet pipes A and E can fill an empty cistern in 12 minutes and 36 minutes respectively. Both the pipes A and E are opened together and after some time pipe, A is closed. Thus it takes 20 minutes to completely fill the tank, then for how many minutes pipe A was open?
questions.solution:
Part of cistern filled by pipe A in 1 min. = 1/12

Part of cistern filled by pipe E in 1 min. = 1/36

Let the pipe A was open for ‘x’ min.

∵ Pipe E was open for 20 min.,

⇒ Total work done = (x × 1/12) + (20 × 1/36) = 1

⇒ x/12 = 4/9

⇒ x = 48/9 min. = 16/3 min.

∴ The pipe A was open for 5(1)/(3) minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e228480450486c059aaa2f8154f86503a89ba29cacd14c5f2154d7d46bc14930.png] 

Formula Used:

Efficiency × Time taken = Total capacity of tank

Total capacity of cistern = LCM of time taken

Calculation:

Capacity of a tank = LCM of 12 and 36

⇒ Capacity of a tank = 36 units

Efficiency of A,

⇒ 36/12 = 3 units per minute

Efficiency of E,

⇒ 36/36 = 1 units per min.

According to the condition, E worked till the work gets completed

⇒ E worked for 20 minutes

Units filled by E,

⇒ 1 × 20 = 20 units filled by E

Remaining units filled by A,

⇒ Remaining units = 36 – 20 = 16 units

To fill 16 units, A will take,

⇒ 16/3 = 5(1)/(3)

**∴ A has worked for 5(1)/(3)** **minutes.**

questions.question: If a pizza is cut into eight equal parts, then what is the angle made by each sector?
questions.solution:
∵ Pizza is in the shape of a circle.

The centre angle of a circle = 360°

∴ Angle made by each sector = 360°/8 = 45°

questions.question: Two boys are building blocks. The first boy’s blocks are 3 cm high and the second boy’s blocks are 9 cm high. How tall will they be when the two are of the same height the second time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of first boy's blocks = 3 cm

Height of second boy's blocks = 9 cm

**Concept used:**

L.C.M × 2 = Tall when both are of same height the second time.

**Calculation:**

L.C.M of 3 and 9 = 9

⇒ L.C.M × 2 = 9 × 2

⇒ 18 cm

**∴ When the height of their blocks will be same the second time, it will be 18 cm tall.**

questions.question: If angles of triangle are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5, then find the angles.
questions.solution:
Let the angles be 3x°, 4x° and 5x°, respectively.

∵ Sum of angles of triangle = 180°

⇒ 3x° + 4x° + 5x° = 180°

⇒ x = 180°/12 = 15°

∴ Angles are 45°, 60°, 75°.

A and B together have Rs. 1,500. If 1/4th of A’s amount is equal to 2/4th of B’s, then how much amount A has?
questions.solution:
A’s amount + B’s amount = 1500 ----(1)

Also,

⇒ 1/4 × A’s amount = 2/4 × B’s amount

⇒ 1/2 × A’s amount = B’s amount

Substituting in (1),

⇒ 3/2 × A’s amount = 1500

⇒ A’s amount = 2/3 × 1500

∴ A’s amount = Rs. 1000

questions.question: The difference between simple and compound interest on Rs. 1,000 for 3 years at 5% p.a. interest is:
questions.solution:
∵ Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

⇒ Simple interest = (1000 × 5 × 3)/100 = Rs. 150

Also,

When the interest is compounded annually,

Compound interest = Principal × [(1 + Rate/100)Time – 1]

⇒ Compound Interest = 1000 × [(1 + 5/100)³ – 1] = 1000 × 0.1576 = Rs. 157.6

∴ Required difference = 157.6 – 150 = Rs. 7.6

questions.question: If (a + 1⁄a) = 3, then find the value of (a⁴ + 1⁄a⁴).
questions.solution:
Given, (a + 1/a) = 3

∵ (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

Squaring both sides,

⇒ (a + 1/a)² = (3)²

⇒ a² + 1/a² + 2 = 9

⇒ a² + 1/a² = 7

Squaring both sides,

⇒ a⁴ + 1/a⁴ + 2 = 49

⇒ a⁴ + 1/a⁴ = 47

questions.question: A and B together can do a task in 5 days and the total unit of work to be done is 40 units. If A alone can finish the task in 20 days, then how many days B will take to finish the task if he does alone?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by A and B together in 1 day = 1/5

⇒ Work done by B in 1 day = 1/5 – 1/20 = 3/20

∴ B will complete the work alone in = 20/3 = (6(2)/(3)) days

questions.question: A man sells a product for Rs. 333 with a profit of 10%. What is the cost price of the product?
questions.solution:
∵ Cost price + Profit = Selling price

⇒ CP + 10% of CP = 333

⇒ 11/10 × CP = 333

⇒ Cost Price = CP = 10/11 × 333 = Rs. 302.73

questions.question: If 2 cos²x – sin²x = -0.25 and 0° ≤ x < 90°, then find the value of x.
questions.solution:
Given,

2 cos² x – sin² x = – 0.25

⇒ 3 cos² x – cos² x – sin² x = – 0.25 [∵ sin² x + cos² x = 1]

⇒ 3 cos² x – 1 = – 0.25

⇒ 3 cos² x = 3/4

⇒ cos² x = 1/4

⇒ cos x = 1/2 [∵ cos 60° = 1/2]

∴ x = 60°

questions.question: How many factors of the number 4000 are perfect squares?
questions.solution:
The factors of 4000 are: 1, 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 16, 20, 25, 32, 40, 50, 80, 100, 125, 160, 200, 250, 400, 500, 800, 1000, 2000, 4000

Out of these, 1, 4, 16, 25, 100 and 400 are perfect squares.

∴ Six factors of 4000 are perfect squares.

Alternate method∶

∵ 4000 = 1 × 2⁵ × 5³

∴ The factors that are perfect square are 1, 2², 2⁴, 5², 2² × 5², 2⁴ × 5².

∴ Six factors of 4000 are perfect squares.

questions.question: Harish switched on a bulb at 01∶23∶44 hours and switched it off on the same day at 11∶14∶38 hours. For how long was the bulb in switched-on mode?
questions.solution:
Required difference = 11 ∶ 14 ∶ 38 - 01 ∶ 23 ∶ 44

We know 1 hour = 60 mins and 1 min = 60 secs

⇒ 11 hours 14 mins 38 secs = 11 hours 13 mins 60 + 38 secs = 11 hours 13 mins 98 secs

Again, 11 hours 13 mins 98 secs = 10 hours 60 + 13 mins 98 secs = 10 hours 73 mins 98 secs

 10 ∶ 73 ∶ 98

__ - 01 ∶ 23 ∶ 44__

 09 ∶ 50 ∶ 54

∴ The correct answer is 09 hours 50 mins 54 secs.
